details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> model : add hy_v4_flash on the DSA iSWA cache (#32960) * model : add hy_v4_flash on the DSA iSWA cache Tencent Hy4 flash is a hy_v4 trunk (iHC, gated MLA, sinks) with sparse and sliding-window MLA layers, sandwich norms, latent routed experts and deepseek41 Engram tables. The sparse layers select their context with a pooled indexer: the keys of 4 consecutive tokens are pooled by a per-channel softmax of a gate plus a position bias, normed, and rotated at the position of the first token. A token attends to the best scored pools of its sequence plus its own pool. The model runs on llama_kv_cache_dsa_iswa as dots3note does. The indexer cache holds the projected value and gate of each token, and the pools are rebuilt from the cells for every ubatch by llama_kv_cache::set_input_kpool(), so there is no pooled state to keep in sync with sequence edits, checkpoints or state save/restore. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: ## Overview llama.cpp v1.1.0 adds the Inkling 2 family (base, Mini and DSpark), Domyn Edge 4B, Zaya1 8B, RAON-1-mini and Hy4 flash, splits DFlash speculative decoding into separate draft methods, and deprecates the old `llama_batch` API in favour of `llama_batch_ext`. It brings a large set of TTS and audio models (Kokoro, Zonos3-Mini, tiny-voca, VoxCPM2, MiniMax-Music3, YuE2, Fish S2, Higgs v3/VibeVoice-ASR and Kyutai Hibiki), token-aware chat parsing, named tool choice, automatic per-tensor quantization targeting a bpw or size budget, a slot-scheduling refactor in `llama-server`, a redesigned Llama Chat web UI with voice messages and agent traces, and updates `ggml` to v1.1.1. ### API changes - llama.h: deprecate the old `llama_batch` API in favour of `llama_batch_ext` and `llama_process` ([#32306](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32306), [#32356](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32356)) - llama.h: add `llama_dflash_variant` and `llama_model_dflash_variant()` for t
